events.verdict: Daniels (ATL) legally contests Merrill's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) and Mobley (CLE) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.

Mitchell (CLE) momentarily applies his hand to Alexander-Walker's (ATL) front, and he immediately removes his hand as he defends the drive.  Alexander-Walker loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of any contact from Mitchell.
Daniels (ATL) initiates contact with Mitchell's (CLE) arm at the end of his drive, and the contact is more than marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) legally contests McCollum's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Merrill (CLE) establishes himself in Daniels' (ATL) path prior to the contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Mitchell (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Daniels (ATL) steps forward into Mitchell's path with his arm extended into Mitchell, and initiates the first illegal contact on the play.  A personal foul is correctly assessed to Daniels after review.
Mobley (CLE) legally contests Kuminga's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Merrill (CLE) and Alexander-Walker (ATL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
McCollum (ATL) and Mobley (CLE) come together as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) brings his hand towards the ball and the contact with Harden's (CLE) arm is marginal.
Harden (CLE) is bracing for the contact from Alexander-Walker (ATL) and he releases away from the contact.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) directly contests Harden's (CLE) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Harden's hand after the release.
Harden (CLE) directly contests McCollum's (ATL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to McCollum's hand after the release.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Mitchell (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hawks.
Allen (CLE) initiates contact with Kuminga's (ATL) arm that affects his shot attempt.
